Manacher.palindromic_length:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Recursively counts the number of matching symmetric character pairs around a center within a string, stopping when the expansion reaches an exclusive boundary or the mirrored characters differ." palindromic_length]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> center </REF>: int "Index of the center position from which symmetric pairs are expanded."
        <REF> diff </REF>: int "Current nonnegative offset from center used to select the mirrored pair to test."
        <REF> string </REF>: str "The string being checked for palindromic expansion."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "The count of valid matching symmetric pairs from the current expansion offset outward, or 0 if the current pair is invalid or out of bounds."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Proceed with the current mirrored pair because the guard condition is false: center - diff is not -1, center + diff is not len(string), and string[center - diff] equals string[center + diff]. RESULT current_pair_valid]
            [COMMAND Return 1 plus the value returned by recursively calling palindromic_length(center, diff + 1, string). RESULT final_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The guard condition is true, evaluated left-to-right with short-circuit OR: center - diff == -1, or center + diff == len(string), or string[center - diff] != string[center + diff].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0 immediately. RESULT zero_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Manacher.palindromic_string:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Finds the longest palindromic substring of self.input_string by building a pipe-separated representation, scanning all centers with palindromic_length, and returning the centered window without pipe separators." palindromic_string]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> output_string </REF>: string "The longest palindromic substring found in self.input_string, with all '|' separator characters removed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize max_length to 0, new_input_string to "", and output_string to "". RESULT max_length, new_input_string, output_string]
            [COMMAND For each character i in self.input_string[:len(self.input_string)-1] (all characters except the last), append i + "|" to new_input_string. RESULT new_input_string]
            [COMMAND Append self.input_string[-1] to new_input_string. RESULT new_input_string]
            [COMMAND For each index i in range(len(new_input_string)), call self.palindromic_length(i, 1, new_input_string), assign the returned value to length, and if max_length is strictly less than length, set max_length = length and start = i. RESULT max_length, start]
            [COMMAND For each character i in new_input_string[start - max_length : start + max_length + 1] (from index start - max_length through start + max_length inclusive, with Python clamping slice indices at string boundaries), if i != "|", append i to output_string. RESULT output_string]
            [COMMAND Return output_string. RESULT output_string]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
